items.prompt: A woman sitting at a table in a restaurant raises her hand to call a waiter who is standing a little away. The red arrow points at the woman.
A young woman hands a wrapped gift box to a young man; the man is receiving it happily. The red arrow points at the man.
At night on a street (moon in the sky), two young women are parting ways and waving goodbye. The red arrow points at the woman on the left.
A schoolboy with a school bag opens the front door of his house and steps inside; his mother is in the hallway. The red arrow points at the boy.
In a classroom, a female student points at a pen on the desk of her classmate sitting next to her, asking to borrow it. The red arrow points at the female student who is asking.
A young woman is struggling to carry a big heavy suitcase and bag; a young man next to her reaches out to help. The red arrow points at the man.
In a quiet library, a woman reading at a table turns politely to a man next to her who is talking loudly on his phone. The red arrow points at the woman.
A sick friend is lying in bed with a cold; a young man standing at the bedroom door is about to leave. The red arrow points at the standing man.
In front of a station clock, a woman arrives running and out of breath, bowing to a friend who has been waiting. The red arrow points at the woman who arrived late.
A tourist man holding a camera approaches a stranger at a sightseeing spot, wanting the stranger to take his photo. The red arrow points at the tourist man.
Inside a train, a young man sitting on a seat looks up at an elderly woman standing in front of him and starts to stand up. The red arrow points at the young man.
A businesswoman at her office desk is talking on the phone, holding a business card. The red arrow points at the woman.
A male student gives a bouquet of flowers to an older male teacher in a school hallway; there is a birthday cake on a nearby table. The red arrow points at the student.
In an office, a young female employee holds some documents and bows slightly to a busy senior colleague working at a computer. The red arrow points at the young female employee.
